items.title: Government publishes new rules to unlock £160bn in defined benefit pension surpluses
items.summary: The Department for Work and Pensions has released reforms allowing defined benefit pension scheme trustees greater flexibility to release surpluses, subject to parliamentary approval.

items.title: FCA sets out accountability expectations for agentic AI in financial services
items.summary: The Financial Conduct Authority has updated its AI guidance to address autonomous agentic systems, confirming that existing regulatory rules apply and no new rules are planned.

items.summary: Insurance Age content for the eighth episode of Broker Expo Bites could not be loaded due to technical issues.

items.title: M&G's Catalyst Growth Equity Fund raises $900m in first close
items.summary: M&G Investments has secured $900m in the first close of its Catalyst Growth Equity Fund, aiming to back technology-led private companies requiring patient capital.

items.title: Daniel E. Pinto appointed as external member of Bank of England Financial Policy Committee
items.summary: HM Treasury has named former JPMorgan Chase Vice Chairman Daniel E. Pinto to a three-year term on the Bank of England macroprudential regulator.

items.title: FCA outlines application and annual regulatory fees for ESG ratings providers ahead of 2028 regime
items.summary: The Financial Conduct Authority has set out proposed application and periodic fee structures for ESG ratings providers as the sector prepares for mandatory authorisation.
